title: CairoGo
shortDescription: An offline-first, accessible Flutter app for planning trips on Greater Cairo's Metro, Monorail, LRT and Ring Road BRT.
tagline: Greater Cairo's rail and rapid-bus network in one bilingual app that works underground, with no signal and with a screen reader.
challenge: Getting around Greater Cairo means piecing together separate references for Metro lines 1-3, the Monorail, the LRT and the Ring Road BRT. Tunnels drop mobile signal, fares differ per mode, and blind and low-vision riders need reliable screen-reader support and clear guidance.
solution: We built CairoGo in Flutter as an offline-first Android app: all stations, lines and fares ship on the device, and our own Dijkstra and Yen k-shortest-paths routing compares up to three routes by time or changes, with fares for every mode. Station search works in Arabic and English, by typing or by voice, with filters per line. Transit GO guides each trip with spoken cues and vibration milestones, and both a schematic map and a text map are included. The app supports English and right-to-left Arabic, light and dark themes and large text, and was designed against WCAG 2.2 AA with automated accessibility tests.

title: MyCoffeeShop
shortDescription: A SwiftUI iOS app for browsing, ordering, and managing coffee shop orders.
tagline: A seamless coffee ordering experience — from menu browsing to order confirmation, built natively for iOS.
challenge: Coffee shop customers needed a smooth digital ordering experience that matched the premium feel of the brand, with real-time order tracking and a clean, intuitive UI that works for all age groups.
solution: We built a fully native SwiftUI app following MVVM architecture, integrating Supabase for authentication and backend. The app features cart management, favorites, promo codes, location selection, and push notifications for order updates — all wrapped in smooth animations.

title: Weather App
shortDescription: A beautiful iOS weather app with real-time forecasts and smooth animations.
tagline: Real-time weather data and 5-day forecasts delivered through a sleek SwiftUI interface with interactive bottom sheets.
challenge: Most weather apps either look outdated or sacrifice usability for aesthetics. The goal was to build an app that feels premium, loads fast, and handles poor network conditions gracefully — all optimized for every iPhone screen size.
solution: Built with SwiftUI following strict MVVM and SOLID principles, integrating OpenWeatherMap's API for live data. Features a custom interactive bottom sheet for forecasts, debounced city search, progressive data loading, and centralized error handling for all network edge cases.

title: MoneyTracker
shortDescription: A personal finance iOS app for tracking budgets, goals, and donations.
tagline: A complete personal finance companion — track spending, set savings goals, manage wishlists, and record donations in one clean iOS app.
challenge: Personal finance apps are often either too complex or too shallow — users needed a single app that covers transactions, budgets, savings goals, shopping lists, and charitable giving without feeling overwhelming.
solution: Built with Swift 6 and SwiftUI using a feature-based MVVM architecture. Supabase handles authentication and data persistence. The app includes a budget dashboard, transaction history with categories, goal progress cards, wishlist management, donation tracking with impact summaries, and a profile overview — all with smooth animations and an onboarding flow.

title: News Cloud (The Chronicler)
shortDescription: A Flutter news reader with live headlines in 7 categories, an editorial article view and Firebase accounts.
tagline: Live headlines across Business, Health, Science, Sports, Technology and more, read in a calm, magazine-style Flutter app.
challenge: Many news apps are cluttered, hard to scan and break quietly when the connection drops. Readers wanted one clean place to skim headlines by topic, read a story comfortably, and keep their own account and reading preferences.
solution: We built News Cloud (The Chronicler) in Flutter with Dio and NewsAPI: a category carousel and headline cards for 7 topics, with loading and error states when the network fails. Articles open in an editorial detail view with the source, a pull quote, an author card and further reading. Firebase Authentication handles sign-up and sign-in, and the profile lets readers edit their name and email, change their password, delete their account, choose notification preferences and switch to dark mode. A Codemagic workflow builds the iOS app in the cloud without a local Mac.

title: La Familia
shortDescription: A native Android messaging app that keeps working offline: messages queue on the device and send themselves when the signal returns.
tagline: Private chats for family and friends that survive dead zones, in English or right-to-left Arabic.
challenge: On weak or patchy mobile networks, chat apps lose or silently drop messages, and people are left guessing whether a message arrived or tapping retry by hand. Many Android chat apps also handle Arabic and right-to-left layouts poorly.
solution: We built La Familia natively in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose around an offline-first design: Room on the device is the single source of truth, so conversations open instantly and messages written without signal go into a local outbox. WorkManager sends them automatically with retries once the device is back online, and every bubble shows its status: queued, sending, sent, delivered, read or failed with tap to retry. Firebase Authentication and Cloud Firestore handle accounts and sync, DataStore keeps theme and language settings, and the whole app supports English and Arabic with mirrored right-to-left layouts in light and dark themes. La Familia is a university team project (Mobile Computing, Phase 1) led by Abdelrhman and still in development; the gallery shows the app's design wireframes.
